sleep_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished website illustration, square canvas, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (our existing daily category illustration). Match its visual grammar closely: extraordinarily thin muted gray-green contour, cream/off-white flat fills, tall slender eccentric adult with tiny elongated nose/profile and simple face, oversized geometric everyday objects, angular/comically large hands and feet, sparse architectural line details, elegant minimal editorial vector appearance with generous negative space. No thick dark strokes, no blue circle/blob backdrop, no gradients, no texture, no realistic rendering, no rounded cartoon character. Subject: sleep and recovery, one slender adult asleep under a cream duvet on an oversized simply drawn bed, tiny bedside stool, tall open window with crescent moon. Cozy understated absurd proportions matching the reference; clear sleeping silhouette at small size. All art must fit within middle 82% of square, clean transparent outer margin, no clipping, no surrounding card, no colored background, no badge, no letters, no numbers, no text or watermark. This will sit to the right of a Chinese sleep question on a pale mist-blue canvas. Produce artwork only, not a UI mockup.
